Impacted Systems: Applications running Log4j package versions 2.0-beta9 to 2.15.0 (excluding 2.12.2) with certain conditions met
Attack Vector: Logging configuration enabling lookups, Pattern Layout with Context Lookup, Logger.printf function with attacker-controlled input
Indicators of Compromise: JNDI lookups to localhost only bypassed, successful arbitrary code execution attacks

Method of Attack: Denial of Service (DoS) and Arbitrary Code Execution
Impacted Systems: Applications running Log4j package version 2.16.0 with certain conditions met
